reviews.title: Exceeded all expectations
reviews.comment:
Take a look at the 1 negative remark I have at the end of this review if this happens to be the one that convinces you to buy.
Exceeded all expectations, plenty of room for any graphics card on the market, looks sharp, solidly built, plenty of cable management options, all panels can be removed for full access extremely easily. I originally was trying to get a different case however due to either amazon or usps logistical issues and not getting that case twice, I opted for this one. I do not regret it in the slightest.
The 1 negative remark is when removing the tempered glass side panel you have to make sure that you have a hand in place to catch the glass. I was not prepared for this the 1st time. I didnt break it but it did come as quite a shock that it was not in a channel guide, hooked in place or something of that nature.
reviews.author: Schnabletier

reviews.title: Beautiful and Great-Value White Case!
reviews.comment:
The darkFlash DY460 White case looks absolutely stunning! The design is clean and minimalistic — that pure white finish gives it such a premium and elegant vibe. It comes with four built-in RGB fans, which look super cool and vibrant once powered on.
The airflow is excellent, keeping the system cool and running smoothly. Building inside this case was a breeze — plenty of space for cable management, and everything fits perfectly. The packaging was also solid and secure, with no damage during shipping.
Overall, this is a great-looking, high-performance, and budget-friendly case. Highly recommend it to anyone who loves a clean white build setup!
reviews.author: Patrick PC
